newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts variable mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts variable mortgage rate.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday it would cut its variable mortgage rate to 8.25 percent from 8.75 effective December 17 for new borrowers and January 27 for existing customers.
The bank said it would not be adjusting its prime lending rate for large corporate customers at this stage.

The Reserve Bank of Australia earlier on Wednesday reduced its official cash interest rate by 0.5 percentage points to 6.00 percent. The ANZ is the last of Australia's "big four" banks to pass on the rate cut to its customers.
